invariants.rationale: The method always returns a Color from either style.disabledFontColor, style.overFontColor, or style.fontColor, all of which are expected to be non-null.

invariants.expression: result == style.disabledFontColor || result == style.overFontColor || result == style.fontColor
invariants.rationale: The returned Color is always one of these three fields based on the method's logic.
If isDisabled() is true and style.disabledFontColor is not null, result must be style.disabledFontColor; otherwise, it is one of the other two.

invariants.expression: isDisabled() && style.disabledFontColor != null ? result == style.disabledFontColor : true
invariants.rationale: If the button is disabled and a disabled color is configured, that color is always returned.

invariants.expression: style.overFontColor != null && (isOver() || scrollPane.hasParent()) ? result == style.overFontColor : true
invariants.rationale: If the overFontColor is set and isOver() or scrollPane.hasParent() is true, result must be style.overFontColor.
